tree-stump.notes: Wide chunky stump with soft bevels, pale ringed cut top, and warm brown bark that matches the contract; silhouette reads instantly at 128 px. The salmon-red blob on the front is off-palette and the hollow is subtle, but neither breaks the style beside hamlet assets.

fern.notes: Arching frond cluster with rounded chunky stems and a small central base; silhouette reads as a fern at 128 px and sits fine in the sunny forest set. Greens run a touch brighter than the #2f7a3f/#4a9a4f contract and fronds read tubular rather than leafy, but the intent is clear.

bramble.notes: Style and palette are on-contract, but the asset reads as a sparse young shrub, not a thorny impassable tangle. It needs denser interwoven canes, more visible thorns, and a darker deep-green body before it can frame the map borders.
